column1: # DRAFT -- awaiting definitive values from J. McKaig. Every field marked PENDING
# is a real gap, not a formatting placeholder. Do not substitute a plausible
# number for a PENDING: a wrong denominator is worse than a visible hole,
# because it propagates silently into every per-femtogram quantity in the paper.
# The experimental measurements this study's headline numbers divide by.
# This file exists because the samplesheets mix two different kinds of thing.
# A `fastq` path is local plumbing, meaningless in someone else's clone. A DNA
# mass is an experimental fact that belongs to the paper. Keeping them in one
# row is how `carrier_dna_ng = 1000` -- a rough prior calculation -- survived
# alongside a documented dilution scheme that yields 1272 ng, without the
# contradiction ever being visible.
# Here, every quantity that divides a headline carries its provenance in the
# same row. A value whose basis is `nominal_unmeasured` is legible as such at a
# glance, which is the entire point.
# Relationship to the samplesheets: `assets/samplesheets/*.csv` supply file
# paths and keys; this file supplies measurements. The two are joined on
# `sample_id` and every sample must appear in both.
# Columns
#   sample_id, experiment, replicate
#       Keys. `replicate` is the label used in this paper; see `legacy_label`.
#   legacy_label
#       What the replicate was called during acquisition. lowinput_s2 was
#       originally r1-r4; r0 here is the original r1. Recorded because run
#       records, tube labels and notebooks predate the renaming.
#   standard, standard_catalogue, standard_lot, input_format
#       The community standard and whether it was supplied as extracted DNA or
#       as intact cells.
#   preps_per_extraction, polyA_ug
#       Extraction inputs. polyA is polyadenylic acid (Roche 10108626001), added
#       before protocol step 5 as an extraction carrier. It acts only during
#       extraction and is not carried into library preparation.
#   sample_dna_ng
#       Sample DNA mass into LIBRARY PREPARATION, in nanograms. This is the
#       denominator of reads_per_fg and bases_per_fg, and the numerator of the
#       input sample fraction that enrichment is referenced to. Not DNA into
#       extraction, and not cell-equivalent mass.
#   sample_dna_basis
#       How that number was obtained. One of:
#         qubit_hs                        reading within the assay's range
#         raw_fluorescence_extrapolated   below range; computed from the raw
#                                         fluorescence of standards and sample.
#                                         An extrapolation, not a reading.
#         qubit_hs_shared_tube            a Qubit reading taken on a source tube
#                                         shared with another replicate, so the
#                                         mass is measured but not measured
#                                         independently for this library
#         nominal_unmeasured              no measurement; the intended value
#         PENDING                         not yet established
#   carrier_dna_ng, carrier_dna_basis
#       Lambda gDNA mass into library preparation. Basis is one of:
#         direct_addition   a measured aliquot added straight to the sample.
#                           Exact; nothing propagates.
#         dilution_series   the endpoint of a serial dilution. Must be computed
#                           from the scheme, NOT assumed to equal the nominal
#                           target -- see the lowinput_s1 note below.
#   carrier_catalogue, carrier_lot
#       Lambda source. Same catalogue number across both sessions; the lots are
#       14 months apart and may differ. See docs/TODO.md item 2, which reports a
#       reproducible difference in the carrier-derived E. coli between sessions
#       that a lot difference is one candidate explanation for.
#   include_in_headline, include_reason
#       Whether the library contributes to the headline per-femtogram and
#       enrichment statistics, and why not when it does not. The reason is here
#       rather than only in prose so that excluding a library is a recorded
#       decision rather than a convention.
#   notes
#       Anything that qualifies the row.
# lowinput_s1 carrier mass: 1272 ng, not the nominal 1000 ng
# Sample and carrier were brought to a nominal 1:1000 ratio by two dilution
# steps, with a FRESH aliquot of carrier added at each step so the carrier was
# not diluted along with the sample. Working the scheme through with the stated
# stock concentrations (community 11 ng/uL, lambda 500 ng/uL):
#   step 1   3 uL community + 3 uL lambda + 44 uL water -> 50 uL
#            community 0.660 ng/uL, lambda 30.0 ng/uL
#   step 2   3 uL of step 1 + 3 uL lambda + 44 uL water -> 50 uL
#            community 0.0396 ng/uL, lambda 31.8 ng/uL
#              (90 ng carried over from step 1, plus 1500 ng fresh)
#   40 uL taken into library preparation
#            community 1.584 ng, lambda 1272 ng   -> a ratio of 1:803
# The nominal 1000 ng is therefore wrong by a factor of 1.272, and enrichment --
# which divides by the input sample fraction -- is understated by that factor.
# The sample masses below are inferred from Qubit measurements and are lower
# than the 1.584 ng the nominal scheme predicts, consistent with the stocks
# having been re-quantified and volumes adjusted. Whether the carrier was
# adjusted in the same way is exactly what needs confirming.
